description: Defines data structures and type aliases for configuring and managing UE (User Equipment) resources and BWP (Bandwidth Part) configurations in a scheduler component of a wireless communication system, including resource allocation, configuration requests, and reconfiguration parameters.

classes.name: bwp_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for a Bandwidth Part (BWP), including identifiers, common and dedicated configurations for downlink and uplink, and associated core sets and search spaces.

classes.name: ue_cell_res_config
classes.description: Resource configuration for a UE in a specific cell, including core sets, search spaces, BWP list, and cell-specific parameters.

classes.name: ue_creation_params
classes.description: Parameters used to generate a UE configuration object, including configuration request, logical channels, and cell configurations.

classes.name: ue_reconfig_params
classes.description: Parameters used to reconfigure an existing UE configuration, including optional logical channel list and cell configurations.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for bwp_config, compares all configuration fields.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for ue_cell_res_config, compares all resource configuration fields.
